description: Returns client timelines from the MORVS Influence Register using a published key or a case-insensitive name substring. The register includes only reports with an AI, surveillance or privacy match in a lobbying-activity section; it is not a client’s complete lobbying history. Amounts are whole-report figures across all issues, never spending on a topic. In-house expenses and outside-firm income are separate and must not be added; subcontract income is excluded. Null is not zero. Filings do not establish a client’s position on a bill or a policy outcome. Returns the retrieval date and the LDA source disclaimer. A missing client is not proof of no lobbying.

client.description: Required case-insensitive client name substring or published client key, at most 80 characters. A missing client is not proof of no lobbying.
